text:
Alex H: Heads up — during a routine logs sweep I found a plain-text JSON blob that looks like an old GCP SA key. Not sure if it was pushed externally, but we should assume potential exposure and act.
Maria C: can you paste the snippet + path? we need to see which project and service account.
Alex H: snippet (redacted):\n```
{"type":"service_account","project_id":"redwood-examples","private_key_id":"abcd1234","client_email":"redwood-batch@redwood-examples.iam.gserviceaccount.com"}
```\nFound in: `projects/redwood-examples/logs/stream-processor/2026-03-27.log` (internal blob retention)
Samir P: ok — treat as compromised. Proposed immediate steps: 1) disable the key(s) 2) create short-lived replacement creds where needed 3) rotate any Vault-stored secrets backed by this SA 4) export audit logs to BigQuery for the last 90 days for triage. Also we should avoid a full mass-rotation if we can do service-by-service rolling swap.
Irene K: +1. I'll take point on coordinating rotation windows with owners. we need an RBAC checklist before rotating — remove iam.serviceAccount.keys.create for broad groups, check roles binding for `redwood-batch` SA.
Leo T: FYI some downstream jobs pin the SA email in configs. We need a discovery pass: grep the infra repo and look at k8s secrets, config maps, and any CI jobs. I'll throttle rotations to off-peak hours and add a safety flag to prevent mass deploys while we swap keys.
Maria C: Samir — any KMS/Vault specifics? our Vault mount uses GCP KMS for auto-unseal and we have a transit key for re-wrapping. Do we need to rekey KMS or just rewrap Vault values?
Samir P: two things: if the SA had access to KMS encrypt/decrypt, rotate KMS keys or restrict IAM on the keyring. Rewrap Vault via transit is safer and quick: `vault write sys/rekey/rotate` is not what we want — instead use the transit rewrap path for affected values. Example rewrap: \n```
vault write transit/rewrap/redwood-batch ciphertext=@wrapped.txt
```\nFor long-lived KMS keys, consider creating a new key version and updating the cryptoKey resource and key rings. Also ensure Cloud KMS audit logs are enabled and exported.
Alex H: also we should update RBAC: create `svc-redwood-batch-limited` role with only the permissions the batch needs (pub/sub publish, storage read) and remove owner/editor bindings from SAs that don't need them.
Irene K: I'll run an access-review playbook: 1) list bindings `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-examples --format=json` 2) find principals with `roles/editor|roles/owner` and map to teams 3) propose scoped role alternatives and file PRs to terraform repo.
rotations-bot: Created ticket SEC-2412 and scheduled initial key disable at 2026-03-27T23:45Z. See https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2412 :lock:
Alex H: for audit: export admin activity + data access logs to BigQuery: `gcloud logging sinks create sec_export bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/sec-bq/datasets/sa_audit --log-filter='resource.type="gcs_bucket" OR protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"redwood-batch"'` — capture all accesses.
Maria C: I'll start the discovery sweep across repos and k8s namespaces. posting a checklist here when done. :thumbsup:
Leo T: note on ops: dependent services might break if we rotate without updating CI. I'll add a pre-check that runs smoke tests in canary namespaces after new key provisioning.
Samir P: vuln triage notes: mark this incident as potential P2, capture all affected secrets from Vault (search by path `secret/data/services/*/redwood-batch`) and rewrap or rotate those entries. Also ensure Vault audit devices are on and immutable for the next 30 days.
Irene K: timeline proposal: discovery (0-2h), disable compromised key (2h), provision replacement creds + rewrap secrets (2-6h), staged rollout + smoke (6-12h), post-rollout audit export + postmortem (24-72h). Thoughts?
Alex H: good. Add a step to update SCC/Alerting: create a rule to fire if any SA keys are checked into logs again. We should also add a CI pre-commit hook that scans for JSON blobs that look like SA keys.
Maria C: will add the pre-commit and send a PR to infra. I'll ping owners for each repo.
Leo T: I'll coordinate deploy-freeze windows and run the canary smoke. tagging @oncall for awareness.
deploy-bot: Deploy window locked for services: `stream-processor`, `batch-ingest` from 23:30-01:30 UTC per SEC-2412.
Alex H: thanks all. keep updates here — if anyone finds an external paste or public exposure, escalate to execs and legal.\nMaria C: ack, posting checklist/first pass in ~30m.
